speaker: Doctor
text: I see you've had fatigue, flank pain, and fever following recent antibiotic treatment for acute sinusitis. Did you finish the entire course of antibiotics as prescribed, or did you stop early?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text: That is concerning; symptoms persisting after sinusitis treatment could indicate a secondary infection or a complication. Did the fever spike suddenly or does it come and go, and did you develop any chills or shaking?

speaker: Patient
text: I was first treated with amoxicillin for sinusitis and developed a rash. Then the antibiotic was changed to cephalexin for another week, and the rash went away.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Pyelonephritis (likely due to inadequate antibiotic coverage or an atypical pathogen given the rash and persistent symptoms).
